summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Agregar Paquete de otra categoría' button (edit-add-package-single) in ShipmentEditDialog single mode. Created a single-category shipment G×4 ($128) for M5358 via UI on a seeded TEST invoice. Clicking Editar showed the button. Clicking it switched to package rows with row0=G qty 4 and row1 empty (qty 1, no category); total stayed 128. Setting row1 to B×1 made the total $180.00 (read-only). After saving, the list showed 'G×4 · B×1 - $180.00 • 5 paquetes' and the DB invoice shipping_cost was 180. On reopen the rows were still there; removing row1 put the total back to $128 and saving persisted it (list 'Categoría G - $128.00 • 4 paquetes', invoice shipping_cost 128). Reopening then showed single mode again with the button visible. Regression: 'Agregar Tracking' added a tracking input and TESTTRK123 was saved and shown in the list.
critical_code_review_comments: If the admin converts to multi rows and saves with row 2's category still empty, the backend (_price_shipment_packages) silently skips that row and the frontend does no validation. Consider showing a toast or validating instead.
Once in multi mode there is no way back to single mode without saving and reopening. Minor UX point.
seed_data_creation: Seeded TEST-UI-MULTI/TEST-UI-LEGACY invoices for M5358 via seed_multi_pkg_ui.py and created 1 shipment via the UI. All of it was removed with cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses the visible input: '[data-testid=login-identifier-input]:visible' (there are 2 inputs). Use seed_multi_pkg_ui.py seed|show|cleanup. Tenant rates: G 32, A 42, B 52 (packages mode).
